summary: Felaris now installs with a proper Windows setup wizard: Start menu and optional desktop shortcuts, an entry in Installed apps with a working uninstaller, and no administrator prompt. Installed copies update themselves through the setup after verifying the download, and Felaris now checks for updates every 6 hours while it is open. Running the new setup over an earlier install replaces it. The old Install to Start Menu button and the --install/--uninstall options are gone.
